s.note: the gym nobody can afford to save
s.how: Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g cheddar and jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top with a jar of salsa, the guacamole and 150g sour cream.

s.note: round, red and ready to throw
s.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with 40g parmesan, chopped parsley and a crushed garlic clove. Roll into 24 balls and brown. Simmer in a tin of crushed tomatoes for 30 minutes. Serve on toothpicks.

m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill to medium. Fry 8 rashers of bacon. Build on toasted buns with cheddar, bacon, iceberg, tomato and pickles. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into fries, twice, and salt.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter. Whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar, then fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Cover with fudge frosting of 300g icing sugar, 40g cocoa and 80g butter, and top with a red fondant ball.

d.how: Stir 500ml orange juice with the juice of 2 lemons, 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of fine salt until the honey dissolves. Pour over ice in four tall glasses and top each with soda water.
